missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend adding or switching folate formulation until prenatal product composition, total folate exposure, gestational context and clinician advice are reviewed.
safety_exclusions: Do not replace prescribed prenatal folic acid with methylfolate based on unsupported superiority claims.
Do not duplicate folate across prenatal and standalone products.
Do not delay antenatal care or neural-tube-defect prevention guidance.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, prior neural tube defect-affected pregnancy, antiseizure medicines, malabsorption, B12 deficiency or high-risk obstetric history.
population_and_context: Pregnant people considering methylfolate or other folate products; prenatal folate strategy and formulation should follow current antenatal guidance and individual clinical context.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Follow current local antenatal folic-acid guidance and clinician-directed formulation/dose; distinguish dietary folate equivalents from supplemental folic acid.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Folate and pregnancy resources provide reference information; formulation choice and dosing require current local obstetric guidance.
